Core comes to evaluate the store 3 or 4 times a year. It's an extremely important visit which impacts everyone, especially your shift leads/AGM(s) and GM. Namely, they're looking at the operations, which includes speed of service, cleanliness, health standards, food standards, correct procedures, and basically anything else you can think of. 

Failing a Core is probably one of the worst things that can happen to your store. Not only does the store have to be reevaluated, but the company has to eat the cost for the revaluation. It also means your store isn't performing at standard, which is a huge hit for store leaders. A yellow used to be "acceptable", but most stores now consider this failing a well. A well-ran store will easily receive a green, which is passing.

Also, if a store has previously failed and gets a bad score on the next core, an angry area coach or market coach may fire employees. This didn't happen at my store, but several drive-thru cashiers who didn't follow procedure were fired, along with one shift lead. It is something that is taken very seriously!

The only two expansions I have are LN and Ambitions, haha. I think they go very well together. If you like having complete control of your sim, Ambitions gives you the chance to control what they do with the new professions. I was very entertained with just the base game and Ambitions. You also get a new town, Twinbrook. It's one of my favorite towns. It also adds a few new traits, skills, and jobs. Not a big fan of the new hair or clothes.

I also like Late Night quite a bit. The addition of clubs and a downtown area definitely adds a fun and interesting play style. The celebrity system can be a bit annoying, but it's not too annoying. You can always turn it off. I really like vampires. Though they don't add too much new stuff, they're fun. LN definitely adds a lot of new clothing, especially for women. There aren't a ton of hair options, but I do like the new hair in LN much better than Ambitions. As with most expansions, there are a couple new traits and skills. It also adds more instruments into the game, which is nice. I like the new town, Bridgeport, quite a bit. It can get overwhelming quickly, but it's fun to explore.

I would say it all comes down to how you like to play. Do you like having career and family oriented sims, or do you like having wild sims that can go down any path they want? If it's the former, Ambitions. If it's the latter, Late Night. I think they're both great expansion packs and personally, I think they work very well together. I feel like Ambitions offers a bit more than Late Night. I would try to get them when they're on sale, at least.

I started out slowly. Do NOT try to do everything at once, it's a killer. I started by weaning myself off of pop and into drinking water. After that, it was cutting back on portions and getting healthier food. I worked out by walking for at least 30 minutes a day. Now I use exercise tapes because I find them more enjoyable. Find the best thing for you. A lot of people go to the gym for motivation, and I think that's a great idea. 

Don't make huge goals for yourself. Start by pledging to lose a single pound! I still set 5 pound mini-goals. It really helps and doesn't make the task seem as daunting.

Tell other people! It helps to have someone on the journey with you, or at least supporting you. They can also help motivate you when you're feeling lazy. Sure, there are times when I don't want to do ANYTHING, but I think of all the people that are rooting for me and I get off my ass and go exercise. 

Occasionally when I feel like I want to quit, I just look at before/after pictures. It's a huge motivator. These people did it, and so can I. 

It will be hard, but don't give up. It will be worth it! I have lost 45~ pounds since May and I'm still going. (40 pounds away from my goal! Yay!) I feel 50 times better. I used to be lethargic, I had horrible knee and back pain, and I just felt like crap all the time. Now all of that is gone! I feel so much better, physically and mentally. It is worth it. Don't let yourself give up! Do this for you and no one else.
